item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 19/Apr/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An upper-air disturbance will bring some showers to southern China in the next couple of days. Under the influence of a southerly airstream, the weather is expected to be humid over Guangdong during the weekend to midweek next week. It will be hot during the day and there will be a few showers.

Date/Month: 20/04 (Wednesday)
Wind: East to northeast force 3 to 4.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with one or two showers. Sunny intervals during the day.
Temp range: 19 - 23 C
R.H. range: 70 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Low
